description: Wairoa Flood 0.1m Urban Aerial Photos (2024) is a dataset listed in LINZ Data Service (data.linz.govt.nz), New Zealand, an open data portal, published or maintained by National Imagery. Orthophotography for this project was captured on 10 July 2024 following a severe weather event on 26 June 2024. As part of the response and recovery efforts for Wairoa, Hawke's Bay Regional Council commissioned an aerial survey of the impacted area of Wairoa township at 10cm GSD. Coverage: New Zealand. The portal files it under the publisher National Imagery. Its tags are imageryBaseMapsEarthCover. It offers 1 resource(s) in raster. The portal shows 2024-07-22 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the portal's own catalogue entry (title, description, tags, licence, formats and dates) read through its API, so the data files were not opened, their contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure hazard and exposure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-nz-linz-portal.
